Package gooeygui

Class Window

java.lang.Object
gooeygui.Window
public class Window extends Object
The main window of a GooeyGUI program. Components are placed in the window using addComponent(Component).

The window's width and height describe the usable area inside the window, not counting the title bar or borders, so a component at y = getHeight() - 30 with a height of 30 fits exactly at the bottom. The window cannot be resized by the user, and closing it ends the program.


 Window window = new Window("My App", 500, 400);
 window.addComponent(new Label("Hello!", 20, 20, 100, 30));

    • Window

      public Window(String title, int width, int height)
      Constructs and shows a window centered on the screen.
      Parameters:
      title - the text shown in the window's title bar
      width - the width of the usable area inside the window, in pixels (at least 1)
      height - the height of the usable area inside the window, in pixels (at least 1)
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if title is null, or if width or height is less than 1

  • Method Details

    • addComponent

      public void addComponent(Component comp)
      Adds a component to the window at the component's (x, y) position.

      This method accepts any kind of component, such as a Button or a Label, because they are all subclasses of Component.

      Parameters:
      comp - the component to add
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if comp is null or has already been added to a Window, Panel, or TabbedPane
